 Dear Sir/ Ma’am,

 This is to inform you that the 38th Annual General Meeting (“AGM”) of the Company will be
 held on Friday, June 26, 2026 at 12.00 P.M. (IST) through Video Conferencing / Other Audio
 Visual Means in accordance with the applicable circulars issued by the Ministry of Corporate
 Affairs (“MCA”) and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (“SEBI”).

 Pursuant to Regulation 34(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
 Regulations, 2015, we are submitting herewith the Annual Report of the Company containing
 the Notice of the AGM for the financial year 2025-26, which is being sent through electronic
 mode to all the shareholders, who have registered their e-mail addresses with the
 Company/RTA/ Depositories.

 The Annual Report containing the AGM Notice is also uploaded on the Company’s website at
 www.ndtv.com.

 We would further like to inform you that the Company has fixed Friday, June 19, 2026 as the
 cut-off date for ascertaining the names of the shareholders holding shares either in physical
 form or in dematerialized form, who will be entitled to cast their votes electronically in respect
 of the businesses to be transacted as per the Notice of the AGM and to attend the AGM.

 You are requested to take the same on your records.

 Thanking you,

 Yours sincerely,

Company Overview




Where Credibility
                                                                                           Today, as part of AMG Media Networks Limited, an Adani Group company, NDTV
                                                                                           is entering a new phase of growth as a future-ready media organisation with an
                                                                                           expanding global presence. The network is strengthening its presence across
                                                                                           digital platforms, broadcast formats and international markets while continuing to



Leads the
                                                                                           remain anchored in the principles that shaped its founding.
                                                                                           With a renewed focus on digital-first innovation, technology-enabled storytelling
                                                                                           and audience-centred content, NDTV is reimagining how news is experienced in a
                                                                                           rapidly evolving media landscape.

                                                                                                                       Programming That Built Market Leadership
                                                                                                                       NDTV Profit strengthened its content stack with a mix of appointment viewing, original IPs, and
                                                                                                                       high-credibility market voices:

Business News –                                                                                                        India Market Open                                          Know Your Company
For Your Profit                                                                                                        A dominant appointment-viewing destination for live
                                                                                                                       market action and real-time insights.
                                                                                                                                                                                  Decoding businesses, leadership journeys, and
                                                                                                                                                                                  corporate fundamentals.
NDTV Profit delivered a defining year in FY 2025-26, marked by strong gains in visibility, audience
engagement and platform relevance. In a short span of time, the channel has evolved from a new
entrant into a credible and fast-emerging contender in the business news landscape.
This momentum has been driven by a clear editorial strategy, making business and financial journalism more
accessible to a new generation of viewers. By engaging younger investors, simplifying financial language and
widening the reach of business news beyond traditional audiences, NDTV Profit has begun to reshape how market
conversations are experienced.
Its de-jargonised, energetic approach to covering markets, money and the economy has resonated strongly with
first-time investors and emerging market participants across India. The result has been a steady rise in viewership,
deeper audience connection and growing relevance in a rapidly evolving financial news ecosystem.
